purpose: Design document defining the abstraction of the four forge wrapper SKILLs (query/update for rules and specs) that delegate document search and index updates to external backends: skill list, arguments, output and SKILL contracts.
summary: Overview: forge delegates document search and indexing to doc-link and doc-db backends via four wrapper SKILLs
Ownership split: this design owns the SKILL abstraction; backend selection and routes belong to DES-057
Skill list table with role, fixed category and user-invocable flag for query-db-rules/specs and update-db-rules/specs
Query flow: resolve backend order, pick first available backend, explicit error if none, no grep fallback
Query output contract: Required documents: path list built by script, common across backends
Query SKILL contract: inherited-type search SKILL, allowed-tools, no fork, args limited to keywords and short task text
Update flow: explicit --backend skips selection and errors if unavailable; otherwise ordered selection
Desired-state rule: .doc_structure.yaml is authoritative and paths not included are removed from the index
Prerequisite: at least one backend available, judged by capability rather than version
Test design: unit tests, lint checks, AI-Linter constraints and wrapper transparency tests
tasks: Modifying or reviewing query-db-rules/query-db-specs SKILL behavior
Modifying or reviewing update-db-rules/update-db-specs SKILL behavior
Designing changes to document search backend integration
Defining or changing SKILL output contracts such as Required documents
Writing or updating tests and lint for query/update wrapper SKILLs
Calling query-db SKILLs from other forge SKILLs
Handling index maintenance delegation from query to update SKILLs
title: DES-001 文書検索ラッパー（forge → 文書検索 backend）設計書
